name: Rags To Riches🤑
desc:
In a future where Earth's trash has overtaken the planet, the KOR Corporation sends waste to distant space islands. Scavenge through the heaps, uncover valuable treasures, and turn your finds into fortune in this galactic trash-picking adventure! Will you rise from rags to riches? 💰

Can you collect all 570+ items?👑 

Rags to Riches is a RNG🍀 based game where you can,👇

🥄Scavenge for popular Roblox limited accessories, equip them, display them and sell them.
✅Complete quests for numerous NPCS.
🔎Discover secrets that reward you for it!!
🛠️Buy better tools that will improve your overall luck and speed!
⚙️Upgrade your tools
😋Eat consumables that increase your luck and speed
And more... !✨

Game inspired by Void Fishing and other games alike!✨

Thank you for your support and don't forget to Keep On Rising! ☝️
